m_Array: So monsters have taken up residence within, you say?

That's right.
Someone went to eliminate them, but they haven't returned...
Sister, please save us!

Monsters living in the monastery is not something we can overlook.
We'll do everything we can.

You say you have purification powers...
Even so, can you really defeat such creatures?

There's no need to worry.
The one carrying out the purging won't be me...

My name is [[PlayerName]].
Purging monsters is my sacred mission.

The situation here in Arcezon...
There must be some will at work that is
bringing to life these Abomination Broodlings.

The monsters are within.
Please take care......
Please save us......

H-hey.
It's going to work out, right?!
[[PlayerName]], this way.
A silver pitcher with holy water inside.
I'm glad to see you're okay, [[PlayerName]].

I'm horrified to say that it appears that an Abomination Broodling
had taken over the nun's body and begun to mutate it.
It's fortunate she was purified before it grew larger.
I'm sure...she would have agreed......

Now then, according to the town residents,
Arcezon has multiple locations where abnormalities have begun to appear.

Those places probably have an Abomination Broodling
exerting some kind of influence on the surroundings, I believe.

Right now, we know of these 2 locations:
<color=#D4A443>Vampiric Swamp</color> and <color=#D4A443>Demihuman Lair</color>.

In the <color=#D4A443>Southwest</color>, there's a swamp known as the Vampiric Swamp.
Its named for the vast numbers of leeches found there.
Please be careful not to lose your footing in the swamp.

In the <color=#D4A443>Northwest</color> are some rocky foothills,
and they say there's a Demihuman Lair there.

Demihumans are cunning and possess the know-how to prepare ambushes and traps.
Please keep an eye out for hiding spots.

The immediate objective is to purge the Abomination Broodlings
that are causing all these monster outbreaks, but...

We can't ignore the hardships faced
by the townsfolk either.
I don't think the townsfolk see me as reliable enough to tell me things.
Maybe they would open up more to someone who earned their trust.

If you're not feeling well,
please come tell me about it.
Make sure you look out for yourself......
Good work, [[PlayerName]].
Very well, this way.
It seems there's nothing abnormal that I can treat.

The ones we know of now are the
 <color=#D4A443>Vampiric Swamp</color> and <color=#D4A443>Demihuman Lair</color>.

What are you……?
……………………!!

Many monsters need magical energy to live.
Since we use purification techniques, there's
more magic in our fluids and blood than most.

If a monster attaches itself to you, resist immediately
and pull it off before it can drain your fluids.

I heard that long ago, many tomes and holy relics
were here in Arcezon.

If you could find purification techniques or relics left behind by the saints or their followers,
they could prove useful in your fights.
Thus, Saint Hildegard spoke:

By absorbing fire, air, water, and earth,
the body generates human blood and is filled with holy magic.

When the support of those elemental pillars collapses,
a wicked slime called Livor emerges in the blood.

Your body possesses strong purifying power.
Even if a monster grabs you, you should be able to break free.

However, if you are caught by monsters many times,
your power will become corrupted, and resisting will become more difficult.

Pray to the Goddess Statue or ask me
if you want the corruption cleansed.

For that, we need to suck out
what's filling your breasts.

Understood.
Then, come closer...

I don't have any <color=#D4A443>medical leeches</color>......
I'll have to ask her for help.

......Understood.
I will assist you.

During the treatment,
the parasite inside will likely struggle.

[[PlayerName]], remain steadfast
and resist the parasite.

Understood.
You're going to fight the harbinger inside you.
Are you prepared?
Please take care......
...For that, we'll need the "Dreaming Elixir."

I can provide the other materials, but you'll have to venture
outside to find the <color=#D4A443>Dream Pollen</color>.

After the Abomination Broodling inside the pregnant woman has been purged,
we'll proceed with your purification, [[PlayerName]].
……[[PlayerName]]!

You're okay... I'm so glad.
It seems the Abomination Broodling inside you was purged.

Well done, [[PlayerName]].
It seems the Abomination Broodling has been purged.
And, your new arrow magic...

It seems purification techniques left behind
by the saints still remain here.

Yes, with the magic of this piercing arrow,
there should be more places you can go as well.
......About the townsfolk captured by the demihumans...

I've given them what aid that I could.
Now they've all returned home to settle down.

While it's hard to say they're safe,
it's a relief that their lives were saved.

We're in trouble!
Demihumans! Demihumans are attacking the town!
I'm glad you're safe...... [[PlayerName]].

The damage seems to be limited to a few injuries
and structural damage to some buildings.

This should keep the
demihumans at bay for a while.

......The situation in this land
isn't normal after all.

Whatever's causing Abomination Broodlings to be born here
needs to be removed, or in the near future this entire land
will be overwhelmed by monstrosities.
Regarding that...

After what happened, the townsfolk seem to have begun to accept us.
I learned a few new things from them.
Have you seen the large cathedral to the East?

Go East along the road and you will find <color=#D4A443>Arcezon Cathedral</color>.
The bridge is broken, and a mass of flesh blocks the path.

When Abomination Broodlings began to be born here,
the priests gathered pregnant women and infants
in the cathedral for treatment and research.

It was said that the priests at the cathedral
identified the cause of these troubles...

However, Abomination Broodlings continue to appear,
and it seems the priests are nowhere to be seen.

What happened in Arcezon,
and how can this situation be resolved?

If we can reach the cathedral,
we may be able to figure this out.

I'll look for a way to get to the cathedral while
I'm out purging Abomination Broodlings.

The townspeople should have more trust in [[PlayerName]] now.
<color=#D4A443>They might be willing to share more detailed information.</color>

There's been no word from the village to the 
<color=#D4A443>northeast</color> for a while, and those who went there to check on them have not returned.

The missing priests were last seen in that village.
We should investigate to find out what happened to them.

There is an old unused road to the <color=#D4A443>Southeast</color> 
that you used to be able to take to get down into the valley.

It is said that there were facilities built in the valley to supply water to the cathedral.
You might be able to reach the cathedral from there.

In order to get down in the valley,
we'll have to repair the path.

Now, the townspeople might be willing to share
<color=#D4A443>more detailed information</color> because they trust [[PlayerName]].
Please ask the townspeople for information.
I see... So the priests were infecting the villagers with parasites...

And if what was written in that book that he had is true,
it's quite terrifying.
The cathedral priests summoned the "Otherworlder" here.

And this Otherworlder may be responsible for the
large number of Abomination Broodlings born here.

Did the Otherworlder put them up to it,
or did they desire it themselves......

The cathedral priests may have
already lost their sanity.

That key the priest had...
Based on its design, it must be from the cathedral.

Since that priest brought it with him,
<color=#D4A443>there's a possibility that this key is needed to enter and exit the cathedral.</color>

......I see.
It seems I'll have to go to the cathedral as well.
Haanja will never make it from the valley floor to the cathedral.

<color=#D4A443>To get Haanja to the cathedral, we'll have to
repair the bridge leading to it.</color>

The bridge is repaired.
Let's get going.
......Well done, [[PlayerName]].

[[PlayerName]], your body......
We'll have to get you purified soon.

The house down that alley, correct?
Allow me to take care of it.
Looks like Haanja isn't back yet......
Should I have gone with her?

Haanja, you're back. 
How did the treatment go?
......Haanja?

Ah! 
Is this the monastery......?
My apologies, I guess I seem to have zoned out.
You're unable to pass through here in the demo version.
The pathway to the valley is broken.
I wonder if someone in town can fix it......

The Arcezon cathedral is past here, but......
It doesn't look like we can get there from here.

<color=#D4A443>If you want to get to the cathedral,
you'll need to find another path.</color>
There's an old well

Just like Goddess statues, you can fast travel
to places that have an obelisk
Arcezon cathedral lies beyond here

To think the spiders could have bred to this extent... 
<color=#D4A443>I'll need to destroy all of the eggs.</color>
It's locked.
(No response……)
(Maybe he's focused on his work.)
That......
Is that a priest......?

There's something in this village after all.
We should be cautious as we proceed.

A strange object seals the gate.
There's an indentation in the middle where something can be placed.
If I place these inside, the gate might open......
---s-gha--hs--

(Ohh……
You've been blessed with a child.)

(Please deliver a resilient body,
for the Father of the Otherworld.)

He has something......
Is this...part of a holy book?

<color=#D4A443>"The Otherworlder, Father of the Otherworld
in the holy sanctuary of Arcezon Cathedral.
He descends through vows and earnest prayer. "</color>

<color=#D4A443>And the Father of the Otherworld melds
with the blood of human mothers.
In the fullness of time, it shall be flesh, a child, emerging as part of Father's body.</color>
……"Otherworlder."

<color=#D4A443>The cathedral priests summoned a being
known as the Otherworlder.……?</color>
It seems he still has something.
……I should head back to Haanja for now.
Am I...inside the body of a huge monster?

Or has the cave itself become a monster?
......I need to escape somehow.
The terrain...has changed?

It seems the monster moved while I was trapped,
<color=#D4A443>and now the layout has changed.</color>
This is......
It seems I'm outside of the creature now.

This architecture...
This probably leads to the cathedral.

But it looks like I need a key......
I should return to Haanja first.
Used the key
Inserted the Eye Crest
Sister, are you going to fight off the demons?

It's dangerous outside.
Please carry some potions from our tavern over there.
......You don't have any potions?
This one's on the house. Take it.

Sorry, the village needs medicine, too.
......If you run out, you can have some.

I saw a zombie come crawling out of a grave!
There's more zombies around the town with each passing day.
Sister, would you be able to figure out what's causing all the zombies to appear?

The Gravekeeper might know something about it.
Please try visiting the <color=#D4A443>graveyard in the Northeast</color>. He should be there.
The Gravekeeper is a man with white hair and a hunched back.

Do you need something here?
......I'm sorry, but I can't let anyone from the church into this house right now.

We still don't fully trust you all.
Try talking to someone else.
......What? I'm not pregnant or anything.

Do you suspect me?
You think I'm pregnant with an Abomination Broodling?

Y-you're......
You saved me during the attack.
Thank you.

......Apologies. Most of my potion stock was
depleted during the recent attack.

If you need medicine, there's a trader
to the East of my shop.
Try asking him.

You... That belly......
It's not an Abomination Broodling, right?

That belly......
You'll be fine, right?

If you work with the little nun at the monastery,
you can get purified like my older sister, right?

You're the one purging monsters, right?
Will you buy something?
Have a look.

I think I can get more consumables.
Come back if you run out of them.

Hmph.
The church has abandoned us, haven't they?

(It seems they don't trust me.
It's going to be hard to ask them anything.)
......Well, since it's you, I could tell you.

They say the cathedral priests all disappeared,
but <color=#D4A443>lately, someone saw a priest at the Northeast Village.</color>

They say that people who went to
check haven't returned.

If you're going to the Northeast Village,
you should be very careful.
......You don't seem like one of the cathedral priests.

We're not on friendly terms with the devoted here.
You should leave soon.

They say that the cathedral priests fled far away
due to this disaster, but......

It's possible that they tried to break the curse of the
Abomination Broodlings, and fell victim to them.

Your...belly......
It's not an Abomination Broodling, right?

......What's this?
Don't come barging in here.
(I can't talk to her right now.)
Hahh...... The cathedral, huh?
Long ago, we all did them a service.

It was for building a well or water collecting area
right beneath the cathedral.

We all worked ourselves to the bones to carry building materials to
the bottom of the valley to make it happen.

The water collection area
the cathedral had them make in the valley......

<color=#D4A443>There might be a path leading to the
cathedral from there.</color>

Be careful.
The path down to the valley
hasn't been used since then either.
H-help me!
Th-thank you...... You saved me.

But there's more demihumans to the
west of town!

There were some powerful-looking demihumans, too,
I'm sure they're leading the others!
The carpenter here lost his daughter recently...

Well, it seems like demihumans took her,
so if she's lucky, there's a chance she yet lives.

......You're going to get assaulted, coming to
the outskirts of town dressed like that.

I hear the carpenter's daughter who was
kidnapped by demihumans actually came back.
What a miracle.
Do you need something from this humble carpenter?
That pathway to the bottom of the valley to the Southeast, huh......

You know, it's not unusual for people to
head outside town and never come back.

You want me to fix some pathway in a
dangerous area like that?
......Leave me alone.

Oh, it's you. I'm grateful for what you've done.
Getting my daughter back from the demihumans.
The Southeast pathway, leading down into the valley, right?

Alright.
I'll head out right away.
It's a bit rushed, but it's done.

I'd have liked to make it a bit more safe,
but I'm working with limited resources.

At the least, you should be able to reach
the bottom of the valley without dying.
Well, take care when you go.

I owe you for saving my daughter, 
but it would be difficult to repair the bridge now.

First off, <color=#D4A443>there's that huge monster
along the path East out of town.</color>

Then, <color=#D4A443>something needs done about the
huge mass of flesh in front of the broken bridge. 
Ask me again after you've dealt with that.</color>
......Understood.

If you've done all that, I can at least
go out and lay some planks on the bridge.

Alright, it should be able to get you two
across to the other side now.
Be careful.

Ah, ahh......
That really hits the spot......

Just adding a little of this powder to my drink does the trick.
The storekeeper doesn't even know about this.

You're asking where I got this powder?
......Well, alright...

<color=#D4A443>I went out from the West road,
and found a strange tree South of town.</color>
I got this pollen from it.

It's dangerous outside now, so I think
it'll be hard to get more.

By the way......
Heheh, you're looking good!

Want to come to my place?
I'll take you in.
Ohh, you took care of the demihumans......

You really are strong, huh.
Here, it's on the house.

You want to know about the cathedral?
......Hmm.

We're in a tavern after all.
Let's discuss it over some drinks.
You still have the drink I gave you, right?
Hey hey, you're falling over.
......Should I take you home?
Heheh, leave it to me.

What?
There's no monsters here.

(I sense hostility.
I won't be able to talk to him now.)

You want to ask me about
the cathedral priests?
......Yeah, I know something.

I have a lot going on.
Come into the house.

Before I talk about the priests,
there's something I've been wanting to
say to you.

The houses around here...
They're all ruined from the demihuman
attack we had recently.

This is all because you messed with them!
How are you going to repay us!?

(I'm pretty sure this area was already ruined
before the attack happened......)

(Even though I defeated them,
I was the one who caused the remaining
demihumans to attack the town......)
......Look, we're not demons either.

Just go along with our whims for a while,
and we're willing to forget the whole thing.
Heh heh heh......
Ah, wait!
......That was close.
It might be best not to talk to those people.

Well aren't you well-behaved?
Heheh, let's go over there.
An old person lives at the very end of this alley and I hear he's sick.
Everyone in town is getting worried.

At the end of this alley, got it.
I'll let Haanja know.
Haanja!
[[PlayerName]], you saved me......
Who are they?

They must have been brainwashed
by the priests from the cathedral.

They may have become aware of our investigation
into the cathedral and tried to put an end to it.

It would have been nice if defeating the priests
had restored them to their right minds...

I know purification power has little effect on humans, 
……but you may have gone a bit overboard on them.

It seems that, going forward, my time will be devoted more
to the treatment of injuries than to the curing of disease.
The cauldron is filled with chemicals.
(I feel like someone's looking at my chest...)

So......
Got captured by demihumans, huh?

The demihumans' den, and this is their prison.
I've been trapped in here for a little while.

I'm the daughter of the carpenter who
lives in the Southern part of town.

The people behind me......are still alive.
They've been here longer than I have,
so they're worn out.

The demihumans try to impregnate human women,
so they regularly come to rape us.

As such, so long as you behave yourself,
they won't kill you.
......Not for a while, anyway.

Let's see... 
When the demihumans rape us, they take us
somewhere else.

If you defeated one while he was trying to take one of us away...
You, at least, could escape.

But be careful.
If you fail, I think
they'll kill you.

If you do manage to escape, run away.
It seems like there's a terrifying creature inside
the cave that the monsters worship.
......A demihuman's coming.

It seems like he wants to take
us somewhere......
[[PlayerName]] removed the handcuffs.

Maybe it's because I'm pregnant,
but the demihumans brought me a meal.
I'm quite suspicious, though......

This is too suspicious......
I can't eat it.

......It doesn't make sense to imprison someone
just to kill them in this manner.
I'll try eating it, to prepare for what's to come.
[[PlayerName]] was handcuffed.

Humans are to take part in the formation
of the world that the Father of the Otherworld is going to create.

Humans in this world were created
with that purpose in mind.
From head to toe, their bodies exist for the Father of the Otherworld.
(Father of the Otherworld, my body...)
(I need to go back to the altar and give birth to a child.)
A ladder is concealed beneath the floor
This is... <color=#D4A443>Another purification technique?</color>

But it's different from the sword and arrow magic that I use.
Something requiring a lot more preparation......

I must investigate this cathedral thoroughly after all.
<color=#D4A443>If I could get Haanja to come here,
we should be able to figure things out.</color>
......Terrible miasma permeates the area.

I wonder if I really should be
going this way......

[[PlayerName]]……
I can inform you of a few important things.

How to face the Otherworlder,
and about a special purging technique.

The way beyond this large door
leads to the holy sanctum at the top of the cathedral.
What's more, <color=#D4A443>the Otherworlder should be at the top.</color>

Otherworlders are beings not of this world.
They have no physical body that we can perceive,
so normally, you can't see them with your eyes.

That's why they seek to be born from human bodies,
so that they may manifest in this world.
However, their forms <color=#D4A443>can be seen if you throw Scivias Powder on them,</color> it seems.

The priests who seek the Otherworlder are
believed to have used that powder.
<color=#D4A443>We need to find out how to obtain Scivias powder.</color>

This altar describes a special purging technique
that can be used to banish the Otherworlder
back to its dimension.
Firstly...... <color=#D4A443>This technique takes time to use.</color>

Then the built-up purification power is
released onto the source point.

A nun once went through that large door,
and tried to use this "mass purging."
However, the spell ritual was interrupted, the spell never activated, and she never returned...

Let us complete the spell.
For her sake, too.

When you're ready, please go through the large door.
I'll take over the ritual.

[[PlayerName]] will
<color=#D4A443>protect me until the mass purging activates.</color>

There are three rooms inside: the Dining Hall, Library
and Treasure Room.

They're all dark and quiet. I doubt anyone's inside,
but......
There seems to be a Dining Hall on the other side of the door.

It's a mess in there, with writhing masses of flesh
infesting every corner.

To search this area,
you'll have to fend off enemies like that as you proceed.

Also, I heard what sounded like the groaning
of a very large creature inside.
Please be very careful.
There's a Library if you go up the stairs.

A large collection of books is kept there,
so there may be some new information to be found.

It might look quiet at first, but I feel an
unusual presence there.
There's a Treasure Room if you go down the stairs.

The church also likes to flaunt the power of saints
with gold and gems, but......
There's a bit too much treasure here, I think.

Although there don't seem to be many monsters there,
there's traps and curses set up in various
places, probably to protect the treasure.

While minor ailments can be treated here,
you must return to the monastery for more serious ones.

Have a look at this.
I found it inside the cathedral.
We should be able to make Scivias Powder with it.

Well done.
Then please pass me those ingredients......
......You must face the Otherworlder in battle.
I'll explain the plan one more time.

<color=#D4A443>Please use the Scivias Powder once you arrive at the top.</color>
You should be able to see the Otherworlder then.

After that, I will continue the mass purging ritual.
However, the activation takes time......
I'll <color=#D4A443>protect Haanja until the mass purging occurs.</color>
This is......?

Those who seek the Father of the Otherworld
must abandon their temporary flesh created by Father.
Like water covers the land, evil deeds cover the flesh.

However, those without a mind to dwell in the Otherworld
may become transparent entities, but that's not a complete Otherworld existence.

Look upon the nearby fire.
Where the flames flicker is where the unshed body still remains.

<color=#D4A443>Transparent entity......
It's where the flames flicker……?</color>
Seems to be an elevator, but it won't move.
Don't look…ljjii :l]……
(This book is written in a unique decorative script, making it hard to decipher)

......This bookstand
looks like an operating lever for some mechanism.

Something made a noise outside of the room.
Seems like the mechanism activated.
The mechanism was already activated
Don't look directly at the...t ,a[ph…… light
(This book is written in a unique decorative script, making it hard to decipher)
This book......
Something's written on the bookstand......
<color=#D4A443>Don't look directly at the eye's light</color>
Now, <color=#D4A443>use the Scivias Powder please.</color>
It seems to have no effect here
Someone, please help me......

Thank you so much! How could I ever express my gratitude?
I would have died along with my unborn child.
(Could it be, inside this woman's belly......)

......It's dangerous outside.
I'll escort you to town.

......and then she saved me from the monsters
and brought me here.
Is that so......
Thank you. You saved my sister and her child.

You're different from those cathedral priests
that take away pregnant women and babies.
It's unfortunate, but listen carefully.

What resides within her womb isn't a human child,
but rather an otherworldly harbinger.

......If left unchecked, it will be born as an
Abomination Broodling from your sister's body.

That would put both your sister
and this village in great danger.
My sister...giving birth to a monster......?
No! Is there nothing we can do about it!?

I can't guarantee anything, but there may
be a way to save your sister.

[[PlayerName]] can enter her dream and fight the
harbinger before it becomes an Abomination Broodling.

First you must create the "Dreaming Elixir" in order to
fight what's inside the pregnant woman.

I can provide the other materials, but you'll have to venture
outside to find the <color=#D4A443>Dream Pollen</color>.
I'm begging you: help my sister!
Now let's go see the pregnant woman.
We have the ingredients for the "Dreaming Elixir."

Now [[PlayerName]] will enter her dream
and purge the Abomination Broodling.

You're about to enter battle with an unknown being
using your spirit.

You may not be injured even in defeat, but
<color=#D4A443>it may have a harmful effect on your mind.</color>

While we have divine protection,
there's no telling how much it can withstand......
Are you prepared?

[[PlayerName]]!
I'm glad you're okay……
The Abomination Broodling residing inside her belly has been vanquished.

......Thanks to you, I seem to be alright.
I'm so grateful.

I shouldn't have tried to have a child
with him after all.

......I'm grateful to you.
Don't go dying out there.
My breasts are too heavy......
......I'm going to have to milk them here.
They're still a bit heavy......
I'll have to get help from Haanja if I want this cured.
Welcome home,Sister Lelia.
